definitions.gloss: to add on; to supplement; to append
definitions.explanation: To add something extra to what already exists.

examples.japanese: ⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{付|つ}け{足|た}して⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

examples.english: The soup was bland so I added more salt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一言|ひとこと}→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧{付|つ}け{足|た}して⟦おく→おく：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: Let me add one more thing at the end.

examples.japanese: ⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{図|ず}→図：03368_zu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|いち}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧{付|つ}け{足|た}し⟦ました→ます：noentry⟧。
examples.english: I added one more diagram to the handout.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{話|はな}し→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{言|い}い→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{忘|わす}れた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧{付|つ}け{足|た}した。
examples.english: After he finished speaking, he added one thing he had forgotten to say.

notes:
FORMATION:
Compound verb: ⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧ (to attach) + ⟦{足|た}す→足す：01168_tasu⟧ (to add). Both halves point the same way, and the result implies the addition is small and comes after the main thing is already in place — an afterthought rather than a planned part.

USAGE:
・⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{付|つ}け{足|た}す (to add information)
・⟦{注釈|ちゅうしゃく}→注釈：09766_chuushaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{付|つ}け{足|た}す (to add notes)
・⟦{調味料|ちょうみりょう}→調味料：04941_choumiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{付|つ}け{足|た}す (to add seasoning)

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive, marking the added item with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ and the thing added to with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: ⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{図|ず}→図：03368_zu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{付|つ}け{足|た}す.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・⟦{書|か}き{足|た}す→書き足す：06851_kakitasu⟧ — to add in writing, specifically.
・⟦{言|い}い{足|た}す→言い足す：30546_iitasu⟧ — to add in speech, specifically.
・⟦{追加|ついか}→追加：04060_tsuika⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — more formal and neutral; the standard word on forms, menus, and in business writing, with no sense of afterthought.
・⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧ — the plain verb "to add," used for ingredients, numbers, and conditions alike, without the "tacked on at the end" feel.
